es: Abre una carpeta y toca un ejemplo para escribirlo en el chat. La mayoría funciona sin IA.
en: Open a folder and tap an example to type it in the chat. Most work without AI.

es: violeta: gasta una llamada de IA

en: amber: change it as you like
Inside live the Sage (AI chats), distilling into wiki entries and the topic tree.
Gathers goals and events from every app; its Timeline offers AI plans (✨).
With the track and finish line drawn you can race against the clock or an assistant; you board the train from the rails.
Courts are played by walking inside; you control the ball by getting close.

With AI it also understands a photo of your dish (logs it estimating macros). Recipes and diets you ask for in the chat come with their image: they take a bit longer to show up and cost the credits shown.
Create, rename and organize rooms. "Delete" removes the room from the house.
With AI you can also attach a receipt photo: it logs the expense.
The day's cultural sections and the assistant delivery use AI inside the app.
With AI: a training plan in its Timeline (✨ button) and illustrative exercise images inside the app.
Table games: snake, tetris, chess, checkers, sudoku, memory, pong, hockey, simon, connect four, space, dino…
The vehicles you ride (bike, motorbike, car, UFO) are under "Character & rides".
Animals: hen, pig, goat, sheep, cow and horse. They eat what you harvest in Food.
In its Timeline you can ask for an AI plan (✨) to push a project forward.
Crops: carrot, lettuce, sunflower, tomato, corn and pumpkin.
Inside live the conversational tutor by level, cards from the chat and cards by topic (AI).

Everything in the editor's Settings tab: language, appearance (light, dark, transparent), icon style, interface theme and font, panel glass, the map's visual style (normal, comic, miniature, retro, neon) with its effects, notifications and backup.
Signing in, restoring a backup and deleting your data are NOT done from the chat: the assistant opens that section so you confirm it yourself.
House theme, sky background, ambient music and your Wrapped recap. Music moods: calma, festivo, nocturno, chiptune, acogedor, energia, estudio, arcade, bosque, viaje, carrera, cajita.
Sides: north, south, east and west (also up, down, left or right).
The assistant remembers facts between sessions. Attach a photo with the clip or dictate with the mic; @app forces where an entry goes.

No-AI catalog: lamp, chair, table, plant, guitar, rug, chest, picture, ball and book. Anything else is generated with AI as a 3D model and saved to your inventory. 2D images are asked for with "create an image of…" and stay in the chat.
Garments: hat, glasses… Parts: head, torso and legs. Vehicles: bike, motorbike, car and UFO (flies with Space/Shift). Views: isometric, third and first person (V key).
With AI, new places geocode themselves and show up as a pin on the world map.
Colors: red, blue, green… or a #hex code. Floor materials and roof shapes come from the editor catalog.
Shortcuts to play with a keyboard. They are not typed in the chat: you use them in the house. They do nothing while you type in a field or with a room open.

Each app logs its own data in your words (use @app to force the destination) and its menus open by name. "With AI" examples always spend an AI call (Pro plan or your key); your custom templates also capture via chat and open by name. Note: the offline parser speaks Spanish, so in English most commands run through the AI.
Garden, farm, tracks and courts live outside the rooms, on the 3D map.
